item.title: March Break fun at the library
item.description: Families looking for fun and affordable activities during March Break will find a full schedule of events at the main branch of the Brantford Public Library from March 14 to 20. Kick off March Break with A Day at the Circus: A Drag Story Adventure on March 14 at 10:30 a.m. at the main branch. […]

item.title: Brant OPP: Police search for suspect after multiple thefts at Paris LCBO
item.description: Brant OPP is asking for public assistance following multiple thefts at the LCBO on Mechanic Street in Paris.

item.title: Grand River Conservation Authority approves $42-million budget for 2026
item.description: In 2026, the GRCA expects to generate about 46 per cent of its own revenue through sources such as admission fees, hydro sales from some dams, property rentals, tree sales, planning permits and donations raised by the Grand River Conservation Foundation.

item.title: NPC chess player's long winning streak ends at high school championship
item.description: Skill on display at PJC as players vie for titles; Results included

item.title: GRCA issues flood watch for entire Grand River watershed as temperatures rise
item.description: The Grand River Conservation Authority (GRCA) has issued a flood watch for the entire Grand River watershed due an increased risk of snowmelt, runoff and ice jam formation.

item.title: Get ready to ride the weather rollercoaster as winter and spring do battle
item.description: March is often a battleground for winter and spring to duke it out, and it appears the fight this month will continue right into April.

item.title: Brantford mayor calls for stable and predictable trade relations during Washington visit
item.description: Preserving and strengthening U.S. and Canada trade relations is vital to the prosperity of cities on both sides of the border, Brantford Mayor Kevin Davis says.

item.title: Adam Jiricek powers Brantford Bulldogs to big win against Barrie Colts
item.description: Defenceman sets franchise record for goals in a season; Dogs back on top of OHL standings
